name: Enoch
overview: The Scriptures present two distinct individuals named Enoch: the eldest son of Cain, who built a city named after his son (Genesis 4:17-18), and the godly Enoch in the line of Seth, who walked faithfully with God and was taken by Him without experiencing death (Genesis 5:18, 22, 24). The godly Enoch is also identified in the genealogy of Christ (Luke 3:37), highlighting his significance in the biblical lineage leading to Jesus. This contrast underscores God's sovereign work through both judgment and grace in human history.
